review_notes: I read the whole file. It only adds theorems: product-image closure, containment of the radical in Borel candidates, and base-change and descent corollaries. It defines no new structures or definitions. The concepts it uses (Borel candidate, solvable-radical candidate, radicals, geometric properties) have no Mathlib counterparts. The file uses Mathlib's `Minimal` and order lemmas directly. I did notice that the library's `HopfIdeal` structure (TauCeti/Algebra/HopfAlgebra/HopfIdeal/Basic.lean:66) runs parallel to Mathlib's `Ideal.IsHopfIdeal` predicate in Mathlib/RingTheory/HopfAlgebra/Quotient.lean. That structure is introduced in another file, not here, so it is outside this target. I did not assess whether the two are redundant. The `IsBorelOverAlgClosed` and `IsBorel` wrappers are named specialisations with distinct hypotheses, so they are not competing versions of a Mathlib concept.
